follow-up time: Time between first and second cesarean delivery
exposure: Use of carboxymethylcellulose adhesion barrier during primary cesarean delivery
outcome: Time from skin incision to neonate delivery at repeat cesarean delivery
cohort: 517 women undergoing primary cesarean delivery followed by a first repeat cesarean delivery
finding: The use of a commercially available carboxymethylcellulose adhesion barrier at primary cesarean delivery was not associated with decreased time to delivery, total operative time, or complications during repeat cesarean deliveries.
